name: 1999ChristmasEve
source:
The protagonist and his female partner are driving to the house they reserved for Christmas Eve when suddenly a creepy voice comes through the radio.

[Translated and summarized from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/1999ChristmasEve]Japanese Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
主人公与女性同伴正驾车前往两人为平安夜预订的房子，收音机里却突然传出一个令人毛骨悚然的声音。

[翻译并概括自[url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/1999ChristmasEve]日文Wikipedia[/url]]
